name: ACS-link
summary: ACS Internet service (acslink.net.au); launched 17 Mar 1994 by Canberra Branch of Australian Computer Society, service commenced 8 Nov 1994.

names.name: ACS-link
source: Tom Worthington (ACS), 'ACS Data Highway Launch 17 Mar 1994': http://www.tomw.net.au/irc/irc12c.html

events.details: Inaugurated 17 Mar 1994 at National Press Club by David Lamont (ACT Legislative Assembly); service commenced 8 Nov 1994 (4,000 members online).

The acslink.net.au website and network were operated by Pegasus Networks Communications Pty Ltd (a Brisbane APC-affiliated ISP); every Wayback capture 1996–1999 presents ACSLink as a Pegasus 'member network' rather than a directly ACS-run service.
